categories.host-optional: Applicability depends on the host, not the edition; already skipped by tools/test262/host-filter.js before execution, so zero scenarios appear in results.json.
categories.post-ES2025-proposal: Finished for ES2026/ES2027 or still a proposal; excluded from the edition-selected score, retained in the broad diagnostic.
categories.required-ES2025: In ECMA-262 at or before ES2025; counted in the edition-selected score.

finished_proposals_provenance.note: Latest commit touching finished-proposals.md at fetch time (commit dated 2026-09-29). The 13 year-based post-ES2025 exclusions rest solely on this list's expected publication years; the pinned corpus features.txt Standard section already lists them (it is stale) and is not used as required-evidence for that set.

ES6RegExPrototypeProperties.rationale: DEFAULT_CONFIG_ES6RegExPrototypeProperties is false (lib/Common/ConfigFlagsList.h:687-690; flag registered at lib/Common/ConfigFlagsList.h:1171); no dedicated feature tag exists, so failures surface under RegExp/Symbol tags and cannot be isolated by tag alone.

ES6RegExSymbols.rationale: DEFAULT_CONFIG_ES6RegExSymbols is false (lib/Common/ConfigFlagsList.h:692-696; flag registered at lib/Common/ConfigFlagsList.h:1180), so the RegExp.prototype[Symbol.*] protocol surface is off by default.

ESSharedArrayBuffer.rationale: DEFAULT_CONFIG_ESSharedArrayBuffer is false (lib/Common/ConfigFlagsList.h:709,1189); Atomics tests in the selected trees exercise the SAB-gated surface.

limits: Tag granularity: a scenario tagged only with required tags (or untagged) can still encode a post-ES2025 draft semantic change to an existing builtin; features.txt asks proposal tests to carry a dedicated flag, but compliance is upstream discipline, not verified here.
Exclusion affects only the edition-selected score; excluded scenarios remain in the broad diagnostic totals and in results.json.
Annex B tags are kept required; whether Annex B is claimed for non-browser embedders is a product decision recorded in doc/c1-triage.md, not silently filtered here.
policy: ES2025 edition selection over the pinned test262 corpus (C1)
rule: A scenario is edition-selected iff none of its attrs.features tags is post-ES2025-proposal or host-optional. Scenarios with no feature tags (recorded as "untagged" in summary.json) are edition-selected: feature tags alone do not define the edition (plan C1), and untagged semantic tests of existing builtins stay in. Anything uncertain stays required; no required feature is ever excluded on doubt.
